params.name: hashid
params.description: The form's hashid (e.g. as found in the form's action URL).

params.name: since
params.description: Return submissions created after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of submissions to return.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of submissions to skip for pagination.

params.name: spam
params.description: Whether to include spam-flagged submissions. Defaults to false.

items.docs: Fetch submissions for a given form, identified by its hashid.
